verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe adding a database from within the builder. Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments, and the app's data then persists across refresh, restart and publish. The homepage also markets Database as a built-in, zero-setup service. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the provisioning flow, and documentation of how the database is wired into the app's code (connection, schema and migration handling).
